registered_before: any referent-time weather was requested, computed or viewed, and any case-crossover model was fitted
status: exploratory grouped cross-validation on already seen events (V0.5 cohort slopes); no new independent test
plan: reports/weiterentwicklung_2026-10-15/UMSETZUNGSPLAN.md, package P4 (case-crossover; renumbered V0.8 because V0.5-V0.7 are taken)
question: Can the weather history before the documented event time distinguish the event time from other times at the SAME slope (time-stratified case-crossover)? Because the slope is identical, terrain, land cover, elevation, infrastructure visibility and reporting placement cancel.
primary_endpoint: conditional logit, variant temporal (INCA windows + same-day rain): unit-weighted local AUC of the event time against its referent times, median over the 5 registered repetitions, with the repetition-1 unit-bootstrap 95 % interval; chance 0.5
decision_rule: Weather is called informative about WHEN a reported slope fails only if the primary interval excludes 0.5; hydrological features count as an added benefit only if the paired interval temporal_hydro - temporal excludes zero. Otherwise: no established signal.
must_not_change: V0.5 dataset, freeze, CV plan and results
V0.6 and V0.7 registrations and results

inputs.positives: the 418 positives of the frozen V0.5 cohort (coordinates, t0, time_quality, independence unit); their event-time features are taken unchanged from that dataset (INCA windows, same-day rain, hydrology from V0.6 hydro.parquet)

design.stratum: one event group = the positive slope: 1 event time (label 1) + up to 4 referent times (label 0) at the identical coordinate
design.referent_time: t0 + offset days, identical UTC clock time; time_quality and local-midnight rule inherited from the event
design.referent_availability: a referent after the last INCA timestamp or lacking a complete admissible 60-day history is dropped and counted; no replacement
design.seasonality_note: referents up to 8 weeks away can fall in another season; temperature windows therefore partly encode season. The same-stratum design cancels any season effect that is common to the slope only if it is monotone over the 8 weeks; this limitation is reported, not corrected
design.future_referents: referents after the event are allowed (bidirectional case-crossover); they use only weather before the referent time, so no information after the referent time enters its features; the event-time features never use post-event data

inventory_exclusion.rule: a referent is dropped if any inventory landslide record (process groups Gleiten/Rutschen, Fliessen, Massenbewegung unklarer Typ) within 1000 m of the slope has a date interval overlapping [referent day - 1 day, referent day + 1 day] (Europe/Vienna days)
inventory_exclusion.date_interval: structured Date_Anfan..Date_End_a if present, else the day/month/year given by EREIGNIS_T/M/J (widest consistent interval); records with no usable date are counted as unchecked

features.temporal: the 18 INCA window features and the 4 same-day features of V0.4/V0.5 (computed with the unchanged V0.4 functions); SPARTACUS and SNOWGRID daily products are not requested for referents (would triple the requests) and are therefore not used in V0.8
features.hydro_note: the three available_water features of V0.6 need SNOWGRID and are not used; hydrological parameters are those of config/v06.json
features.static: none - identical within a stratum, constant terms cancel in the conditional likelihood

models: conditional_logit (primary) and hist_gradient_boosting with the unchanged V0.5 hyperparameters; no tuning
cross_validation: the frozen V0.5 plan (folds by independence unit, 5 repetitions); the spatial purge of that plan is kept unchanged (conservative)
metrics: local AUC per group over its k referents (k varies 3-4), unit-weighted; chance 0.5; top-1 and MRR as secondary
reference: V0.5 neighbour-slope out-of-fold local AUC of the same variants on the same groups (spatial contrast, different question)
diagnostics: local AUC without the largest unit
local AUC by referent side (before / after the event)
interpretation_limits: a case-crossover answers 'when', not 'where'; event times are conservative lower bounds, so the true failure may be later and the pre-t0 rain of the same day is missing for unknown time of day; inventory entries are not a complete record of failures at the referent times (referents are pseudo-negative times); INCA is 1 km
